description:
**WHO YOU ARE** 




  





 We are seeking a Software Engineer to join our dynamic team, dedicated to advancing IKEA's digital infrastructure and capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for building, deploying, and maintaining web applications. They bridge the gap between development and operations teams by automating workflows and ensuring a smooth development lifecycle.
   

 We expect you to be tech agnostic. You should feel comfortable working with a variety of technologies. Experience with cloud\\-native app development on GCP – you have a good understanding of cloud storage, databases, serverless and you understand how to use cloud\\-native in production.
   

 The IKEA culture and values are very much a part of our business and day to day work life. For you to thrive and grow with IKEA it’s important for us that you share our values! You can read more regarding our values and life at IKEA on our website www.ikea.com.
   

  

 • Proven experience in Frontend development with clean, efficient, and well\\-documented code using various languages including Typescript and Python.
   

 • Experience with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) services such as BigQuery, CloudSQL, and Pub/Sub, or similar cloud\\-based data processing technologies.
   

 • Proficiency in programming languages commonly used in application development, integrations, data engineering, such as Python, and experience with related frameworks and libraries.
   

 • Knowledge of data warehousing concepts and experience with relational databases.
   

 • Understanding how to manage complex state in a front\\-end application
   

 • Familiarity with DevOps practices for continuous integration and deployment of data pipelines, including version control systems like Git.
   

 • Ability to collaborate effectively with cross\\-functional teams to understand data requirements and deliver solutions that meet business objectives.
   

 • Alignment with IKEA's values and vision of creating a better everyday life for the many people, with a passion for leveraging data to drive positive change.
   

  

 This is our wish list! If you don’t recognize yourself in all these points, you might still be an excellent candidate for the role.
   

  

 The must\\-haves we see for this role is though:
   

 • Formal qualifications in computer science, software engineering, or an equivalent engineering discipline
   

 • Minimum 5 years of experience as a software engineer, data engineer, or equivalent, working in agile and iterative teams
   

 • Absolute understanding of Git (branching, merging, rebasing, pull requests) and platforms like GitHub or GitLab.
   

 • Strong programming and data manipulation skills using Typescript, Nodejs/Python and advanced SQL
   

 • Familiarity with at least one of the databases –PostgreSQL, BigQuery.
   

 • Familiarity with at least one of the databases Firestore, MongoDB and Elasticsearch
   

 • Proven experience building system REST APIs or Graphql undestanding
   

 Good to Have
   

 • Knowing how to set up automated testing and deployment pipelines (e.g., GitHub Actions)
   

 • Knowledge of caching using Redis or Memcache.
   

 • Experience with frameworks like Django, FastAPI for backend and React/Angular for Frontend
   

 • Expeirence with Graph databases like Neo4j
   

 • Experience around analytics tools like Power BI/Looker/Apache SuperSet
   

 • Experience with authentication and Authorization protocols (Oauth/Jwt)
 



  





**A DAY IN YOUR LIFE WITH US** 




  





 You’ll be a vital part in the transformation of IKEA into a more front line obsessed company by ensuring that we constantly understand what our co\\-workers are telling us.
   

 This mean that you will:
   

  

 Drive modern software engineering principles, utilization of proper tools and create a strong digital foundation for IKEAs Digital products and business.
   

 Other responsibilities:
   

 • Design, develop, and implement Typescript/Javascript, Python and SQL code with CI/CD pipelines on GCP using tools like Github Actions or Cloud Functions.
   

 • Manage infrastructure using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools like Terraform or Cloud Deployment Manager.
   

 • Monitor application and infrastructure health and troubleshoot issues
   

 • Collaborating with stakeholders to understand requirements and develop solutions that address business needs.
   

 • Implementing best practices for reliability and performance optimization.
   

 • Contributing to the automation of data pipeline deployment and monitoring using DevOps practices and tools.
   

 • Participating in code reviews, knowledge sharing sessions, and continuous learning activities to enhance your skills and contribute to the team's success.
 



  





**TOGETHER AS A TEAM** 




  





 We’re the ones who make it possible for people to have a smarter life at home and a hassle\\-free and rewarding shopping experience. Together we work to find new digital solutions for every business need to help make IKEA a great and efficient place to work. We like to think of ourselves as innovative and modern, and we believe that nothing would actually work without us.

title: Software Engineer, Frontend/Fullstack
description:
**We are WisdomAI.**
*We exist to help people unlock clarity from complexity.*
 WisdomAI builds AI\\-powered analytics that put answers directly in the hands of the people closest to the business. Our platform doesn’t just surface insights — it explains the why behind them, helping teams move from data to decisions with speed, confidence, and context.
   

  

 We’re trusted by companies like Cisco, Patreon, and Rubrik — and we’re just getting started.The problems here are hard, and the expectations are high. Our team is energized by both. If you’re compelled by ambitious problems, high standards, and meaningful ownership, you’ll thrive here.
   

  

**This role**
 Backed by Wisdom's adaptive context layer, at the core is generative UI: the charts, dashboards, and insights are generated, not built screen by screen. And it runs wherever people already are: web, mobile, Slack or embedded within their web app. The problems are hard, the UX has no playbook!
   

  

 You own a user\\-facing surface end to end and sweat how it feels. We're hiring at the mid to senior level, with room for staff engineers who still love to build.
   

  

 How we work
   

  

**Builders:** 
 You're a frontend engineer at heart. Some of us run 50/50 frontend and backend. Some stay frontend\\-heavy on the hard UI and visualization work. We build the role around you.
   

  

**Ownership** 
 :Engineers own projects here, from requirements to ship. PMs and designers are partners and input, not a queue you wait behind. Wherever the work starts, we build it – together.
   

  

**Proximity:** 
 You'll work closely with customers, through sales and support and as directly as you want. Staying close is how any of us build something people love to use.
   

  

**Judgement:** 
 We all work across the stack with AI doing a lot of the typing. Cursor, Claude Code, Codex, pick your flavor, most of us use all three. So the job isn't typing anymore. It's taste and judgment about what's worth building and whether it's any good.
   

  

**Fluidity:** 
 The work spans three teams: Dashboard \\& Visualization, Chat \\& Context, and Agents \\& Integrations. You'll land where you fit and where the work is, and move between them as the product grows.
   

  

 What you'd work on
   

  

 A few of the problems open right now:
   

  

* Generating code that produces visualizations good enough to ship: charts, and dense P\\&L tables where every number and pixel has to land. Two hard parts. The data transforms that turn raw rows into a real financial statement, and chart specs that come out looking like a pro built them, without latency growing as the visual gets more complex.
* Designing the edit experience for AI\\-generated visuals, where typing a follow\\-up and reaching for a knob should feel like the same product. Live\\-preview controls only work if the visual comes out parameterized in the first place, with the knobs UI built from those parameters.
* Streaming a chat agent's thinking as a trace you can click into, so a business user can watch what it did and open any step while it's still running. The trick is turning a messy pile of tool calls into something that reads like a sentence. It should earn trust in the answer and still get out of the way of the result.
* Building the React SDK other data teams build on, to drop in dashboards and chat or assemble something of their own with WisdomAI underneath. It lives or dies on the abstraction: the APIs, the docs, the examples that make building on us feel easy instead of like a fight.


 You may be a good fit if you
   

  

* Ship with React, TypeScript, and Node, and obsess over the polish and the details
* Have product instinct: you can take a fuzzy customer pain and decide what's worth building
* Run on high agency, you find the work and drive it instead of waiting for a ticket
* Want customers close enough that they shape what you build
* Have a Bachelor's in Computer Science or equivalent


 Strong candidates may also have
   

  

* Data viz, BI, GenUI or dashboarding experience
* A real eye for design and polish
* Time at an early\\-stage or founding team


 Not sure this is the right fit?
   

  

* Backend engineer at heart who'll happily dip into UI when needed? Check out Software Engineer, Backend @ WisdomAI
* Design engineer who wants to live in design systems, Figma, and interaction craft? Check out Design Engineer @ WisdomAI


**Our CRAFT**
 CRAFT isn’t a list of aspirational values. It’s how we hire, how we promote, how we resolve hard calls, and how we stay honest with ourselves.
   

  

**C — Customer trust.** 
 Everything starts here. We listen carefully, act with integrity, and respond with urgency. Delight is downstream of trust — never the other way around.
   

  

**R — Relentless on outcomes.** 
 We move with urgency, take initiative, and see things through. Effort isn’t the measure — results are. If something isn’t working, we change the approach now.
   

  

**A — Authenticity.** 
 We say the hard things, directly and with respect. We also show up as full humans. That combination is how trust is earned and how we grow together.
   

  

**F — First principles, grounded in reality.** 
 We don’t accept “that’s how it’s done.” We strip problems to what’s actually true and build up from there — then validate quickly and let real\\-world results decide.
   

  

**T — Transparency.** 
 We share the why, not just the what. When something can’t be shared, we say so. We’re one team — information flows so we can do our best work and challenge each other when we’re wrong.
   

  

**Equal opportunity employer**
 WisdomAI is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. We are committed to building a diverse, inclusive team where everyone can do their best work.

title: Software Engineer (Full-Stack)
description:
***About WhiteBird***




 WhiteBird is an AI\\-first startup building multi\\-tenant SaaS for higher education. Colleges and universities run on software that is a decade behind; we are replacing it with a modern product suite where every institution gets its own deployment, data, and customisations.
 



 We are a small team of engineers. Code you write ships to real institutions in days, not quarters, and you will see it land. There is nobody between you and the product.
 



  





***About the role***




 As a Software Engineer (Full\\-Stack), you will own work from schema to UI to production, with no handoffs. You will build and ship products across a TypeScript, Next.js, Node/Bun, Postgres and Prisma stack while taking responsibility for deployment, automation and long\\-term maintenance.
 



  





***What you will do***




 \\- Ship full\\-stack features end to end: Next.js frontends, Node/Bun APIs and Postgres schemas.
 



 \\- Build new products from zero, taking an empty repository all the way to production.
 



 \\- Own deployment and infrastructure, including Vercel projects, database provisioning, migrations, environment configuration and CI/CD.
 



 \\- Work on a multi\\-tenant architecture where deployment is a first\\-class engineering problem.
 



 \\- Automate repetitive work through internal CLI tooling, deployment scripts and sync automation.
 



 \\- Make architecture decisions early and maintain those decisions as the products grow.
 



  





***What we are looking for***




 \\- 1–3 years of experience building and shipping real software. Freshers with a strong portfolio of deployed work are encouraged to apply; we judge the work, not just the years.
 



 \\- Strong TypeScript skills. It is the language of our entire stack.
 



 \\- Real Next.js and Node/Bun experience, including App Router, server components and the production details that matter.
 



 \\- Comfort with databases: schema design, migrations and reliable queries. We use Postgres with Prisma.
 



 \\- Shipped, functional applications that people have used—not only tutorials or unfinished side projects.
 



 \\- Experience with Tailwind and shadcn/ui, or the ability to pick them up quickly.
 



 \\- Genuine curiosity about how systems work. You read the source when documentation is thin, have opinions about architecture and can defend them.
 



  





***Bonus, not blockers***




 \\- Experience with multi\\-tenant or multi\\-deployment architectures.
 



 \\- Git beyond the basics, including rebase, cherry\\-pick and resolving real conflicts.
 



 \\- Docker and self\\-hosted deployments.
 



 \\- GitHub Actions.
 



 \\- Experience maintaining software with real users.
 



  





***AI\\-native is a hard requirement***




 You should already use tools such as Claude Code, Codex and Cursor as a core part of how you build, daily, not occasionally. We are looking for someone who has rewired their workflow around these tools and ships at a pace that demonstrates it.
 



 \\- You can take an idea to working code in hours, not days.
 



 \\- You direct AI tools with strong context and tight feedback loops, and know when to stop and write the code yourself.
 



 \\- You review generated code critically; speed without judgment only creates faster bugs.
 



 \\- If you can describe your AI workflow in specific detail, you will stand out.
 



  





***What you get***




 \\- Your name on whole products: you will be able to point at an app and say you built it.
 



 \\- A small team with no layers, stand\\-up theatre or long waits for decisions.
 



 \\- A capable laptop and the AI subscriptions you need, paid for.
 



 \\- Hybrid work: deep work can happen at home and decisions happen together in the room.
 



 \\- Early ownership and growth without waiting in a promotion queue.
 



 \\- Exposure to hard problems early, including multi\\-tenant architecture, deployment automation and running a fleet with a small team.
 



 \\- Dehradun at the foot of the Himalayas, with short commutes and easy access to Mussoorie and Rishikesh.
 



  





***Quick Details***




 Location: Dehradun, Uttarakhand (Hybrid)
 



 Employment type: Full\\-time
 



 Team: Engineering
 



 Experience: 1–3 years
 



 Core stack: TypeScript, Next.js, Node/Bun, Postgres, Prisma, Tailwind, shadcn/ui
 



  





***How to apply***




 Please send:
 



 1\\. Your resume.
 



 2\\. Your GitHub or portfolio—we care about this most.
 



 3\\. One project you are proud of and what was hard about it.
 



 4\\. A specific description of how you use AI tools day to day.
 



  





 No cover letter is required. Show us what you have built.
 



  





 Careers page: https://whitebird.ai/company/careers/software\\-engineer\\-full\\-stack
 



 Email: careers@whitebird.ai

 This is a full\\-time, on\\-site Robotics Engineer role based in Ahmedabad. Responsibilities include collaborating with cross\\-functional teams to translate requirements into technical specifications, implementing and optimizing software for robotic platforms, and supporting deployment and troubleshooting in real\\-world environments.  We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Robotics Engineers with a strong focus on ROS2 development to join our dynamic team. As a Robotics Engineer, you will be responsible for designing, developing, and implementing advanced robotic systems and applications using the Robot Operating System 2 (ROS2\\). You need to develop the behavioral and control systems, including planning and navigation needed for autonomous robots. This role requires a deep understanding of robotic software architecture, proficiency in ROS2, and experience with hardware integration and real\\-time systems and expertise in URDF (Unified Robot Description Format).

 Develop robust and scalable robotic applications using ROS2\\. Implement software for various robotic systems, ensuring high performance and reliability.
 



 Hand\\-on with developing ROS2 nodes, Services/Clients, Publishers/Subscriber.
